objectives.description: Create test-gate8-expected-new-distinction.sh, structurally modelled on existing fixture suites
Build fixture target so Gate 8 actually runs (manifest.json, copied run-all.sh, hand-built .claude/scripts/ omitting task-lock.sh)
Invoke SOURCE-STORE verify-deploy.sh with --only-gate 8 <fixture> for every case

Case B (genuinely-NEW): non-zero exit, [FAIL] narrative, FINDING gate8 line
Case C (clean): exit 0, [PASS] narrative, no WARN
Case D (mixed): non-zero exit, FINDING gate8 line present
Register the suite in manifest.json provides.scripts and suite-classification.data
